title: Scans show a second Grand Gallery inside the Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: looks like there's a second Grand Gallery above it uh within within the pyramid. That shows up in scanning.

plain: A writer on ancient civilisations named Graham Hancock says on Jesse Michels' podcast that scans of the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt seem to show a second Grand Gallery. The Grand Gallery is the tall, sloping passage already known inside the pyramid, and Hancock says the scanning shows what looks like another one above it. If so, the pyramid would hold large hidden spaces nobody has entered.
